Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:07. The shot begins from <Picture 2>: a full shot of the plain through the haze: the canvas tilts of heavy waggons and the shapes of mounted men showing dark through the drifting dust in a straggling line that runs from one edge of frame to the other. The camera is at the edge of the plateau, level with a standing man's chest and four long strides from the drop, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera. The camera tracks a long stride to the right across the whole shot as the line of waggons and riders comes on across the salt at a walking pace, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 the dust rolls up from the wheels behind them, and the roll continues to the last frame of the shot.
